hints: Focus on the reaction type here, a diol plus a carboxylic acid with acid catalyst means esterification.
Count the atoms, ethane-1,2-diol ($\text{C}_2\text{H}_6\text{O}_2$) plus two ethanoic acids ($2 \times \text{C}_2\text{H}_4\text{O}_2$) minus two waters gives $\text{C}_6\text{H}_{10}\text{O}_4$.
Look for the structure with both -OH groups converted to $\text{CH}_3\text{COO-}$ ester groups, leaving no free -OH and no $\text{-OCH}_3$ groups.
walkthrough:
**Spot the reaction type**

Think like a chemist. Alcohol + carboxylic acid with acid catalyst is esterification.

$$\text{R-OH + CH}_3\text{COOH} \rightleftharpoons \text{R-OOCCH}_3 + \text{H}_2\text{O}$$

**Use the diol and the formula**

Ethane-1,2-diol has two -OH groups, so it can react once or twice. Let's test the full reaction with two acids.

$$\text{C}_2\text{H}_6\text{O}_2 + 2\text{C}_2\text{H}_4\text{O}_2 \rightarrow \text{C}_6\text{H}_{10}\text{O}_4 + 2\text{H}_2\text{O}$$

**Check the atom balance**

Left side carbons: 2 + 4 = 6. Hydrogens: 6 + 8 - 4 (lost as $2\text{H}_2\text{O}$) = 10. Oxygens: 2 + 4 - 2 = 4. This matches X exactly, so X must be the diester, not the monoester.

**Pick the diester structure**

The product must keep the central $\text{-CH}_2\text{-CH}_2\text{-}$ from the diol, joined through two $\text{-O-}$ links to two $\text{CH}_3\text{C=O}$ groups from ethanoic acid. That is $\text{CH}_3\text{COOCH}_2\text{CH}_2\text{OOCCH}_3$.

options.A: This is the monoester, $\text{HOCH}_2\text{CH}_2\text{OOCCH}_3$. Only one -OH has reacted, so its formula is $\text{C}_4\text{H}_8\text{O}_3$, not $\text{C}_6\text{H}_{10}\text{O}_4$. It is an incomplete reaction product.
options.B: This is the diester, $\text{CH}_3\text{COOCH}_2\text{CH}_2\text{OOCCH}_3$. Both -OH groups of the diol have formed ethanoate esters. Its formula is $\text{C}_6\text{H}_{10}\text{O}_4$ and it is exactly what you get from ethane-1,2-diol + 2 ethanoic acid.
options.C: This is dimethyl butanedioate, $\text{H}_3\text{COOCCH}_2\text{CH}_2\text{COOCH}_3$. Although its formula is also $\text{C}_6\text{H}_{10}\text{O}_4$, it contains $\text{-OCH}_3$ groups and cannot be made from ethane-1,2-diol and ethanoic acid. It is the wrong connectivity.
options.D: This structure mixes a methyl ester at one end and an ethanoate ester at the other. It has the right formula but the carbon skeleton is wrong, it does not contain the intact $\text{-OCH}_2\text{CH}_2\text{O-}$ unit from ethane-1,2-diol plus two $\text{CH}_3\text{CO-}$ units.
